solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cartoon dog without tail trailed by cunning philosopher

indicators.note: trailed by puts the next piece behind the first, so it follows it
a word lacking its tail has its final letter cut off

parts.note: Pluto is Mickey Mouse's dog in Disney cartoons
arch can mean knowing, sly or cunning

explanation.surface: A cartoon dog loses its tail and is followed around by a crafty thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without tail' drops the last O of PLUTO, leaving PLUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Plutarch was a Greek writer and Platonist thinker of the first century AD.

clue.text: Bound to get left on shelf

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so this letter comes first

parts.note: a bound is a limit or boundary, an edge

explanation.surface: Someone is doomed to be left on the shelf, unwanted.
explanation.definitionFit: A ledge is a narrow shelf jutting from a wall or rock face.

clue.text: Sort of test coming up for boy

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the letters are read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: the MOT is the annual roadworthiness test for British cars

explanation.surface: A kind of exam is approaching for a young lad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' turns MOT around. The MOT is Britain's yearly vehicle safety check.
explanation.definitionFit: Tom is a common short boy's name, so it stands for a boy.

clue.text: English city's giving wish for peace — small number turned up

parts.note: RIP, rest in peace, is the wish carved on gravestones

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: No. is the abbreviation for number

explanation.surface: A city's people express hope for peace while only a few turn up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' makes NO into ON. Ripon is a small cathedral city in North Yorkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Ripon in North Yorkshire holds city status thanks to its cathedral.

clue.text: Poor actor to make jokes about in bed

parts.note: a ham is a bad, overacting performer
to mock is to ridicule or make fun of

explanation.surface: People mock a bad actor while he lies in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A hammock is a hanging bed of netting or canvas, slung between two supports.

clue.text: Graduate meeting church composer

indicators.note: meeting sets the two pieces side by side, one joining the other

parts.note: a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate

explanation.surface: A university graduate meets a composer of church music.
explanation.definitionFit: Johann Sebastian Bach was the German baroque composer.

clue.text: Something hard about a role for French emperor

indicators.note: about means going around, so one piece wraps the others

parts.note: bone is a hard tissue
a part is a role in a play

explanation.surface: A tough character is cast as the French emperor.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon Bonaparte crowned himself Emperor of the French in 1804.

clue.text: Something to smoke in bed — brave man gets tucked in

indicators.note: something tucked in is placed inside, here inside the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
a hero is a brave man

explanation.surface: A brave man settles under the covers and lights a cigar in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheroot is a cigar with both ends cut square, made for smoking.

clue.text: Something cheesy coming from pantomime dame

indicators.note: coming from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A corny joke from the man in a dress at a Christmas pantomime.
explanation.walkthrough: A pantomime dame is a man in drag playing a comic older woman in a British Christmas pantomime.
explanation.definitionFit: Edam is a Dutch cheese; 'cheesy' here is literal, not corny.

clue.text: Serious-looking fellow embarrassed about perfume

parts.note: po-faced means solemn, so PO can stand for serious-looking
a man is a fellow

indicators.note: about here means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: an embarrassed person goes red

explanation.surface: A solemn man blushes when perfume is mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: A pomander is a ball of scented substances carried or hung to give off fragrance.

clue.text: Repaired tent I now entered

indicators.note: things repaired are put back together, so these letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Having fixed the tent, I go inside it now.
explanation.definitionFit: To go into a place is to enter it; the phrasal verb is a plain synonym.

clue.text: Lean bit we chewed — this washed it down?

indicators.note: food that is chewed is broken up and churned, so these letters are mixed

explanation.surface: We chewed a lean piece of meat and wonder what drink helped it down.
explanation.definitionFit: Everyday wine served with a meal is what helps the food down.

clue.text: Support for champ, finally

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Backing for a champion, at last.
explanation.definitionFit: A prop is something that holds up or bears weight, a support.

clue.text: Move awkwardly in sleep, hiding head

indicators.note: hiding its head means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: slumber is sleep

explanation.surface: Someone shuffles clumsily while asleep, head under the covers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hiding head' drops the S of SLUMBER.
explanation.definitionFit: To lumber is to walk heavily and clumsily.

clue.text: International organisation, one with something banal that can't be believed in!

parts.note: UN is the United Nations
I is the Roman numeral one
corn is trite, hackneyed material

explanation.surface: A global body joins forces with some trite nonsense nobody could believe in.
explanation.definitionFit: The unicorn is a mythical beast, so belief in it is fanciful.

clue.text: Sailor with external support gets new beginning

indicators.note: with external means the second piece sits outside, wrapping the first

parts.note: a rest is a support, as for a cue or arm
tar is an old word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman propped up from outside makes a fresh start.
explanation.walkthrough: Tar is an old nickname for a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A restart is starting again, a fresh beginning.

clue.text: King meeting a judge for contact sport

indicators.note: meeting sets the pieces next to each other

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
to rate is to judge or assess

explanation.surface: A king encounters a judge at a martial arts bout.
explanation.definitionFit: Karate is a Japanese martial art of strikes and kicks, a contact sport.

clue.text: Cut up cubes

definitions.meaning: to chop food into small pieces

explanation.surface: Chop into small cubes.
explanation.definitionFit: Dicing chops into small squares; dice are the spotted cubes of games of chance.

clue.text: Has a feeling religious groups will contain unique selling point

indicators.note: contain means one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: sects are religious groups
USP is the marketing abbreviation for unique selling point

explanation.surface: A believer senses that churches will need a marketing hook.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspect something is to have a hunch or inkling about it.

clue.text: Woman in garden is lifting something to sift soil?

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting raises the letters so they read upwards, backwards

parts.note: Eve was the woman in the Garden of Eden

explanation.surface: A woman in the garden is lifting a tool to riddle the soil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lifting' turns IS into SI. The garden is Eden, not the gardener's plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A sieve, or riddle, separates fine soil from stones.

clue.text: American lover once wearing brown

indicators.note: the piece wearing the other has it on, inside

parts.note: tan is a light brown
an ex is a former lover

explanation.surface: A former partner dressed in brown turns out to be American.
explanation.definitionFit: A Texan is a person from Texas, a US state.

clue.text: Party friend keeping in control

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the word sits inside

parts.note: mate is a friend

explanation.surface: A party pal stays in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: The word 'in' is used as it stands.
explanation.definitionFit: To dominate is to rule over or command.

clue.text: Succeeding with trap, catching ten

indicators.note: a net catching something holds it inside

parts.note: a net is a trap
X is the Roman numeral ten

explanation.surface: Success comes when the trap snares ten.
explanation.definitionFit: The next thing is the one following or coming after.

clue.text: Head old teaching union

definitions.meaning: the National Union of Teachers, merged in 2017

explanation.surface: A headteacher leads the former teachers' union.
explanation.definitionFit: Nut is informal for the head; NUT was Britain's main teaching union.

clue.text: Foursome in concert on a single occasion

indicators.note: a foursome in means four letters taken from inside the word

explanation.surface: A quartet played in concert only one time.
explanation.definitionFit: Once means one time only, a single occasion.

clue.text: Standing in train, get flustered

indicators.note: someone flustered is in a muddle, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A commuter on a crowded train standing up gets in a fluster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flustered' rearranges TRAINGET. To stand someone a drink is to treat them.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing a round means paying for someone, which is treating them.
